title: Greet and introduce yourself
bridge: Na español, po na kosala mosolo tokoluka na 'Hola' to 'Buenos días', mpe po na kolanda na 'Me llamo...' to 'Soy...'. Na anglais ezali mpenza : tokosala mosolo na 'Hello' to 'Good morning' mpe tokoya 'My name is...' to 'I am...'. Lisusu ezali ete na anglais tokoki kolandela na 'I am called...' (ozali ya semba malamu, kasi ezali ya motuya mpe ezali ya kozala na ndenge ya kosala mosolo ya mokolo na mokolo). Lisusu kokumbama ete na anglais tokosala ntina na verbu 'to be' po na kozwa ye na nkombo: 'What is your name?' (kasi 'How are you called?').
rule: Po na kosala mosolo: 'Hello' (Hola), 'Hi' (ya motuya mingi), 'Good morning' (Buenos días), 'Good afternoon' (Buenas tardes), 'Good evening' (Buenas noches po na kozala). Po na kolanda: 'My name is...' (Me llamo...) to 'I am...' (Soy...). Po na kozwa ye na nkombo: 'What is your name?' (¿Cómo te llamas?). Po na kosala mosolo: 'Nice to meet you' (Encantado/a de conocerte) mpe mosolo ezali 'Nice to meet you too'. Po na kozala: 'Goodbye', 'Bye', 'See you later'.

common_error.explanation: Na español tokoya 'Me llamo Anna', kasi na anglais ndenge ya kozala mingi po na kolanda ezali 'My name is...' to 'I am...'. 'I am called' ezali malamu kasi ezali ya motuya mpe ezali ya kozala na ndenge ya kosala mosolo ya mokolo na mokolo.

examples.note: Mosolo ya mbotama.
Ndenge ya kozala mingi po na kozwa ye na nkombo.
Nzela ya kozwa ye na nkombo.
Kozala ya motuya mingi.

title: Koma maloba ya yo moko (mbula, lifuta, salu)
bridge: Na español, mpo na kozonga mbula tozali koyeba 'Tengo 25 años' (kozala na verbu 'tener'), kasi na anglais bazali koyeba 'I am 25 years old' (kozala na verbu 'to be'). Kaka mpo na lifuta tozali koyeba 'Soy español' (kozala na verbu 'ser' mpe kozala na article), kasi na anglais bazali koyeba 'I am Spanish' (kozala na verbu 'to be' mpe kozala na article). Mpo na salu, na español tozali koyeba 'Soy profesor' (kozala na verbu 'ser' mpe kozala na article), kasi na anglais bazali koyeba 'I am a teacher' (kozala na verbu 'to be' mpe kozala na article 'a' to 'an').
rule: Mpo na mbula: 'I am [número] years old' (mbala: I am 25 years old). Mpo na lifuta: 'I am [lifuta]' (mbala: I am Spanish, I am Mexican). Mpo na salu: 'I am a/an [salu]' (mbala: I am a doctor, I am an engineer). Mpo na kopona: 'How old are you?' (Mbula nayo ezali nini?), 'Where are you from?' (Ozali kotika wapi?), 'What do you do?' (Oyalaka nini?) to 'What is your job?'.

common_error.explanation: Na español tozali koyeba 'Tengo 25 años' kozala na verbu 'tener', kasi na anglais bazali kozala na verbu 'to be' mpo na mbula. Ezali molongo ya kopesa likambo mpe mpenza mpo na bato bazali koyeba español.

examples.note: Tozali kozala na 'to be' mpo na mbula.
Kozala na article mpo na lifuta te.
Kozala na article 'a' to 'an' mpo na bisalu.
Kopona mpo na kotika.

translations.ln: Koma maloba ya yo moko (mbula, lifuta, salu)

title: Describe objects and people (basic)
bridge: Na español, po na kosala ba lokola na bato tozali kosala motuna na nsuka ya liboso: 'un coche rojo', 'una chica alta'. Na anglais, motuna ezali liboso ya liboso: 'a red car', 'a tall girl'. Lokola yango, tozali kosala verba 'to be' po na kosala makambo oyo ezali ya solo (She is tall) mpe 'have got' po na kosala makambo oyo ezali ya nguya (She has got blue eyes).
rule: Po na kosala: 1) Motuna + liboso (a big house). 2) Moyebi + verba 'to be' + motuna (The house is big). 3) Moyebi + 'have/has got' + makambo (She has got long hair). Ba motuna ya solo: big (mokolo), small (mobali), tall (mokolo), short (mobali), beautiful (nzoto), old (mokolo), young (mobali), fast (mokolo), slow (mobali).

concept_examples.translation: Ye azali mokolo mpe na nguya.
Ye azali na ma yeux ya bleu.

common_error.explanation: Na español, motuna ezali na nsuka ya liboso ('un coche rojo'), kasi na anglais motuna ezali liboso ya liboso ('a red car'). Oyo ezali ndakisa moko ya kopesa ba erreurs ya solo po na ba oyo bazali koyeba español.

examples.note: Motuna ezali liboso ya liboso.
Tozali kosala 'to be' po na kosala makambo oyo ezali ya solo.

examples.translation: Ye azali na tshomba ya kolongola.
examples.note: Tozali kosala 'have got' po na makambo oyo ezali ya nguya.

examples.original: My brother is young and he has got green eyes.
examples.phonetic: /maɪ ˈbrʌðə ɪz jʌŋ ænd hiː hæz ɡɒt ɡriːn aɪz/
examples.translation: Ndoko na ngai azali mobali mpe azali na ma yeux ya vert.
examples.note: Kosala ya 'to be' mpe 'have got'.

title: Talk about daily routines
bridge: Na español, po na kozonga mambu ya mokolo na mokolo tosilaka verba ya présent simple: 'Me levanto a las 7, desayuno y voy al trabajo'. Na anglais, tosilaka verba ya présent simple na nzela moko: 'I get up at 7, have breakfast and go to work'. Lisusu ya mpenza ezali ete na anglais tosilaka prépositions 'at' po na ba heure ('at 7 o'clock'), 'in' po na ba partie ya mokolo ('in the morning') mpe 'on' po na ba jour ('on Monday'). Mpe tosilaka ba adverbes ya fréquence lokola 'always', 'usually', 'sometimes' liboso ya verba ya mpenza.
rule: Po na kozonga mambu ya rutine: 1) Silaka verba ya présent simple (I get up, she works). 2) Silaka ba expressions ya temps: 'at' + heure (at 8 am), 'in' + partie ya mokolo (in the morning), 'on' + jour (on Friday). 3) Silaka ba adverbes ya fréquence liboso ya verba (I always eat breakfast). 4) Po na komema: 'What time do you get up?' to 'When do you have lunch?'.

concept_examples.text: She usually has breakfast at 8 am.
concept_examples.translation: Yaye akosala déjeuner na 8 na bubu.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ʃiː ˈjuːʒuəli hæz ˈbrekfəst æt eɪt æm/

concept_examples.text: We go to work at 9 in the morning.
concept_examples.translation: Tokoki kobima na travail na 9 na bubu.
concept_examples.phonetic: /wiː ɡəʊ tə wɜːk æt naɪn ɪn ðə ˈmɔːnɪŋ/

concept_examples.text: What time do you have dinner?
concept_examples.translation: Na nki ye ozali kosala dîner?

common_error.wrong: I am eating breakfast every morning.
common_error.explanation: Na español, mbala mosusu tosilaka présent continu po na ba actions ya coutume ('estoy desayunando cada mañana'), kasi na anglais, po na ba rutine mpe ba habitudes, tosilaka présent simple, te continu.

levels.label: Daily actions
levels.translation: Ba actions ya mokolo na mokolo

examples.translation: Nazali kosukola na ntango ya zulu.
examples.note: Verba na présent simple po na rutine.

examples.phonetic: /aɪ hæv lʌntʃ æt wʌn piː em/
examples.translation: Nazali kosala déjeuner na 1 na ngonga.
examples.note: Tosilaka 'at' po na ba heures ya mpenza.
Adverbe liboso ya verba ya mpenza.

examples.original: What time do you go to bed?
examples.phonetic: /wɒt taɪm duː juː ɡəʊ tə bed/
examples.note: Question na 'what time' + do/does.

title: Kobola mpenza na mpenza te (Nalingi / Naliki te)
bridge: Na espanyol, po na kosalela mpenza, tosilaka verba 'gustar': 'Me gusta la pizza' (na ntina ya solo 'La pizza me gusta a mí'). Na anglais, tosilaka verba 'like' na mbongo ya sujet + like + objet: 'I like pizza'. Eloko ya mposa mobimba ezali ete na espanyol, verba 'gustar' ekokani na objet (me gusta la pizza, me gustan las pizzas), kasi na anglais 'like' ekokani na sujet (I like pizza, He likes pizza). Kosi kokoma ete po na kosalela mpenza te, tokolaka 'I don't like' (no me gusta).
rule: Po na kosalela mpenza: 1) Afirmativo: I/you/we/they like + objet (I like coffee). He/she/it likes + objet (She likes coffee). 2) Negativo: I/you/we/they don't like (I don't like tea). He/she/it doesn't like (He doesn't like tea). 3) Botosi: Do you like...? (¿Te gusta...?), Does she like...? (¿Le gusta a ella...?). 4) Po na kopesa mposa: 'I like it very much' (Me gusta mucho) to 'I really like it' (Me gusta mucho).

common_error.explanation: Na espanyol, motuna 'mucho' ekomi na nsuka ya verba: 'Me gusta mucho la pizza'. Na anglais, motuna 'very much' ekomi na nsuka ya motindami to na nsuka ya objet: 'I like pizza very much'. Kobongisa yango kati na verba na objet ezali likambo mabe ya solo.

examples.note: Verba 'like' na ntina ya base.
Tosilaka -s na liboso ya elongo ya esambo.
Tosilaka 'doesn't' + verba base.
Botosi na 'do' + sujet + verba base.

title: Ask for and give prices
bridge: Na espanyol, mpo na komema ndenge ya komonisa boyi, tokoloba '¿Cuánto cuesta?' to '¿Cuánto es?'. Na anglais, tokoloba 'How much is it?' (moko) to 'How much are they?' (mibalé). Tosali kosalela 'How much does it cost?' (¿Cuánto cuesta?). Bosongi malamu ezali ya solola ete na anglais tosalaka mboka na mboka 'to be' to 'cost' na motindameli 'does' mpo na kosala bosoli. Mpo na komema boyi, tokoloba 'It is [número] dollars/euros' to 'It costs [número].'
rule: Mpo na kosala bosoli ya boyi: 1) 'How much is it?' (mpo na mokolo moko) to 'How much are they?' (mpo na mibalé). 2) 'How much does it cost?' (¿Cuánto cuesta?). 3) 'How much is the T-shirt?' (¿Cuánto cuesta la camiseta?). Mpo na kosala likambo: 'It is 25 dollars' to 'It costs 25 dollars'. Na mikolo, tokosala mboka na mboka 'to be' to motindameli 'does' + 'cost'.

common_error.explanation: Na espanyol tokoloba '¿Cuánto cuesta?' ntoko motindameli te. Na anglais, na mboka na mboka 'cost', tokoki kosalela motindameli 'does' mpo na kosala bosoli. Ezali molongo moke ya kopesa ba lokole ya espanyol mpo na kopesa na kopesa.

examples.note: Tosalaka 'to be' mpo na komema boyi.

examples.original: How much does the bag cost?
examples.note: Tosalaka 'does' + 'cost' mpo na komema boyi.
Tosalaka 'costs' na liboso ya liboso ya liboso.
Tosalaka 'are' mpo na mibalé.

title: Indicate location of places / Komonisa likámá ya bangonga
bridge: Na español, po na komonisa likámá ya ngonga, tokolí 'Está en la calle...', 'Está al lado del banco', 'Está cerca de la estación'. Na anglais, tokosala bato na bato oyo ezali na ndako na yango, koti 'on', 'in', 'at', 'next to', 'near', 'opposite', 'behind', 'in front of'. Bosaleli ya lingala ezali ete na español tokosala 'en' na nionso, kasi na anglais, bato oyo ezali na ndako na yango ezali na bosaleli ya ndenge nini. Komona ete po na komonisa likámá tokosala verba 'to be' (It is...).
rule: Po na komonisa likámá: 1) Kosala verba 'to be' (The bank is...). 2) Bato oyo ezali na ndako na yango: 'on' (na, na likámá ya ngonga), 'in' (na ndako ya ngonga), 'at' (na likámá ya ngonga), 'next to' (na banda ya), 'near' (na banda ya), 'opposite' (na muke ya), 'behind' (na nyoso ya), 'in front of' (na muke ya). 3) Po na kosala nsozi: 'Where is the...?' (¿Dónde está...?) to 'Is there a... near here?' (¿Hay un... cerca de aquí?).

concept_examples.text: The supermarket is near the park.
concept_examples.translation: Magasin ya makasi ezali na banda ya parc.

concept_examples.text: The school is next to the church.
concept_examples.translation: Ecole ezali na banda ya église.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðə skuːl ɪz nekst tə ðə tʃɜːtʃ/

concept_examples.text: The pharmacy is on Main Street.
concept_examples.translation: Pharmacie ezali na rue ya Principal.
Oyo ezali likámá ya gare ya biso?

common_error.explanation: Na español tokolí 'Está en la esquina' mpe kaka motoya ezali kobimisa. Na anglais, motoya 'It' to 'He/She' ezali ya makasi. Mpe, 'en la esquina' tokolí 'on the corner' (kasi 'in the corner') soki likámá ezali na likámá ya bangonga.

examples.original: The cat is in the garden.
examples.note: Tokosala 'in' po na bangonga oyo ezali na ndako.

examples.original: The restaurant is next to the hotel.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈrestrɒnt ɪz nekst tə ðə həʊˈtel/
examples.translation: Restaurant ezali na banda ya hôtel.
examples.note: Tokosala 'next to' po na bangonga oyo ezali na banda.

examples.original: The bank is opposite the park.
examples.translation: Banque ezali na muke ya parc.
examples.note: Tokosala 'opposite' po na bangonga oyo ezali na muke.
Nsozi ya ndenge nini na 'Where'.
